doc.name: A — cycling catalogue, sunbeam blinds, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: aero road helmet
Category: cycling
Shot programme: sunbeam blinds
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You run the tabletop stage for a premium cycling product shoot. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the in-context lifestyle in a sunbeam blinds treatment.

SUBJECT. A aero road helmet. The reference image governs silhouette, material finish and every printed mark. Reproduce the label text exactly as it appears; never invent new copy, logos or claims.

CAMERA. Product in its real use environment with lived-in supporting props. Shoot on an 8mm circular fisheye at f/4, framing for leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with a large overhead octabox with a black flag killing the floor bounce. Stage the product on or against brushed aluminium, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.
